summary: The typed tool now reads the origin of an owner turn from the Companion's run registry file instead of an HTTP status lookup, so a written app turn keeps the app surface (samantha_android) even when the Companion is too busy to answer during a long turn. Samantha Voix hand-overs, unknown runs and an unreadable registry keep the live-voice restriction.
reason: S24 07/11 17:54, after core#563: « mon solde orange » shared from the app was refused again (orange_cellular_required_wifi_kept, wifi_disabled false). The registry row of run_1794070429687_2980847e had no voiceDelegation, but the dialogue decision for that exact run carried surface claw_live: the 1.5 s HTTP lookup fell back. A probe of GET /v1/runs/<id> every 200 ms during a 47 s written turn got no answer within 3 s for about 40 s.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-typed-app-surface.cjs
tests.evidence: Real 17:54 row in an S24-sized registry (386 runs, >1 MB) gives samantha_android in well under a second while a Companion that never answers is listening, with no HTTP request; voiceDelegation, unknown run, bad id, corrupt, oversized and missing registry keep claw_live; the typed Orange call reaches the helper with graphSurface samantha_android; rows written by the real reserveSubmittedRun are read back correctly. On the previous HTTP lookup the same test fails at the silent-Companion assertion.

openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-owner-turn-admission.cjs
tests.evidence: Local CI of c2a9a4e8 (4 parallel jobs) read the run state 150 ms after a background failure and saw running; the test now reads the state until it settles (3 s at most). 80 cases green, also 6/6 runs idle and under CPU load before the change.

capabilities.reason: No route, action or capability change; same samantha_android / claw_live surfaces as core#563.

architecture.reason: The Companion's existing run registry stays the only owner of the turn origin; the typed tool reads its atomically replaced file (12-17 ms for 1 MB on the S24) instead of its busy HTTP endpoint. No new store or field.

limitations: Why the Companion stopped answering HTTP for about 40 s during a long turn is not fixed here; it is measured in the fixture and needs its own investigation (it also delays the app's polling).
The 15:17 network_snapshot_unavailable transient of the guard remains separate.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the previous Companion.
